subject: Biology
title: Biodiversity: Why Variety Matters
description: A quick, practical guide to Biodiversity: Why Variety Matters.

hook.text: Earth is home to an estimated 8.7 million species, most of them still undiscovered.

buildup.text: Biodiversity means the variety of life at every level—genes, species, and ecosystems.

discovery.text: Diverse ecosystems are more resilient. If one species fails, others can fill the gap.

twist.text: Species are going extinct up to 1,000 times faster than the natural background rate.

climax.text: Losing biodiversity weakens ecosystems, reduces food security, and limits future medicines.

quiz.question: Why are diverse ecosystems more resilient?
options: Other species can fill gaps when one fails

details.summary: Biodiversity measures the variety of life at genetic, species, and ecosystem levels. Higher biodiversity strengthens ecosystem resilience, increases productivity, and provides essential services like pollination, water purification, and climate regulation that humanity depends on.
details.whyItMatters: Earth is losing species at 100 to 1,000 times the natural background rate. Every species lost weakens the web of ecological interactions, threatening the ecosystem services that sustain agriculture, medicine, and clean water.
takeaways: Biodiversity includes genetic, species, and ecosystem diversity
More diverse ecosystems are more resilient to disturbance and disease
An estimated 8 million species exist, but most remain undiscovered

faq.question: Why does losing one species matter to an entire ecosystem?
faq.answer: Species are interconnected through food webs, pollination, seed dispersal, and nutrient cycling. Removing one species can cascade through these connections, causing population crashes or explosions in other species and destabilizing the whole system.

faq.question: How do scientists measure biodiversity?
faq.answer: Species richness counts the number of different species in an area. Species evenness measures how balanced their populations are. Together these form diversity indices. Genetic diversity within species and variety of ecosystems in a region are also measured.
